hook.name: CharityHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for charity token launches that charges a 1–10% trading tax (with an anti-snipe surcharge that decays over a configurable window) always in the pool's paired asset, accruing fees as ERC-6909 claims per pool, then distributing them among a protocol treasury (30%), a per-launch charity, and the token creator on sweep.
